# Payment Terms and Methods

## Early payment discount

Customers who pay within 10 days of the invoice date receive a 2 percent discount on the invoice total. The discount does not apply to partial payments.

## Accepted payment methods

We accept bank transfer, cheque, and UPI. Cash payments are not accepted for invoices above 20,000. Cheques must be made payable to the company name shown on the invoice.

## Partial payments

Partial payments are allowed. The remaining balance stays outstanding and keeps its original due date. Payments are applied to the oldest invoice first.

## Disputed invoices

If a customer disputes an invoice, they must notify us in writing within 15 days of the invoice date. Disputed amounts are paused from collections while under review, and undisputed amounts remain due.
